description: Migration: create asset_maintenance_occurrences table (tenant-distributed, RLS, composite PK, status enum open|completed|skipped|cancelled, ticket_id, history_id, skip_reason, closed_at/by)
Migration: partial unique index enforcing at most one open occurrence per (tenant, schedule_id)
Migration: backfill one open occurrence per active schedule from next_maintenance
Migration: add archived_at to asset_maintenance_schedules for archival delete semantics
Action listMaintenanceOccurrences: tenant-wide, filters (client, asset type, maintenance type, status, assignee, due range, search), pagination + sorting, joins asset/client/ticket state
Action getMaintenanceAggregates: overdue, due today, upcoming 7d, open maintenance tickets, compliance (on-time completions / occurrences due in period)

Action createOccurrenceTicket: idempotent create-or-return of the single open ticket for an occurrence; writes asset_associations link and occurrence.ticket_id; carries client, asset, plan reference, due date, description context, maintenance source marker

Action completeOccurrence: atomic transaction writing history row, closing occurrence, advancing next_maintenance from completion date via cadence, opening next occurrence; rejects non-open occurrence (double completion) and cross-asset/cross-tenant use
Action skipOccurrence: closes occurrence as skipped with reason, advances schedule to next due, opens next occurrence, no history completion record
Action setSchedulePaused: pause cancels the open occurrence; reactivate recreates one from recomputed next due
Schedule create/update keeps its open occurrence due_date in sync with next_maintenance
deleteMaintenanceSchedule becomes archival when history exists (is_active=false + archived_at); hard delete only when no history
Reject 'custom' frequency in completion advancement instead of silently treating it as daily
Replace /msp/assets/maintenance FeaturePlaceholder with production page (server component: route guard, session, initial data, force-dynamic) composed via packages/msp-composition

Workspace client shell in packages/assets: Command Center layout — KPI SummaryTile band wired to getMaintenanceAggregates, Work queue | Plans | History tabs, master-detail split (worklist grouped by client, occurrence detail pane with meta grid, inline assignee reassignment, checklist, timeline, sticky Complete/Skip/Pause bar)
Work queue left-pane List | Calendar view toggle: month calendar with colored occurrence chips, month navigation, chip click selects into the shared detail pane; filters apply to both views
Workspace toolbar: search, Reset, DropdownMenu multi-select filters (status, client, type, assignee), due-date range, active-filter badge pills
Due & Overdue and Upcoming views listing occurrences with plan, asset link, client, type, cadence, due date with overdue age, status pill, ticket chip, assignee, actions
Plans view: all schedules incl. paused/archived state, active toggle, edit via existing dialog, archive action
History view: completions and skips with performer name resolved, notes, linked ticket, plan and asset links

Create-ticket action in workspace: renders QuickAddTicket via AssetCrossFeatureContext prefilled with client/asset/maintenance context; existing open ticket renders as chip that opens ticket drawer instead

Completion drawer (workspace + asset tab): performed date, performer default current user, notes, optional lightweight checklist stored in maintenance_data, live next-due preview anchored on completion date
Skip dialog with reason selection, recorded on the occurrence and shown in History
Asset detail Maintenance tab: add Complete action, ticket chip, pause toggle, resolved performed_by names in history
Deep links: workspace rows link to /msp/assets/[id] and open ticket drawer; asset Maintenance tab links back to workspace filtered to the asset
Mobile/REST compatibility: /api/v1 maintenance record path routes through completeOccurrence semantics (double-completion rejected), preserving existing request contract
In-app due/overdue signal: workspace badge counts computed live from occurrences (no email/Teams claims in v1)
Compliance metric replaces history-count proxy everywhere it is shown (asset tab report, client summaries, workspace) with the on-time definition
i18n: all new workspace/dialog strings in msp/assets namespace across supported locales
Automation ids (withDataAutomationId / stable element ids) on all new interactive elements
Authorization enforcement per matrix on every new action (asset:read/update/delete + ticket permissions), with cross-tenant/cross-asset rejection
